description: Reg. § 1.1411-4(g)(9): losses allowed by reason of § 469(g) are properly allocable deductions. Single, wages $300,000, interest $50,000; a passive rental (no active participation) sold entirely for a $10,000 gain (entered in the gain facts) with $30,000 of suspended losses: overall loss $20,000, every loss allowed. NII = 50,000 + 10,000 − 30,000 = $30,000; MAGI 330,000 → NIIT 3.8% x 30,000 = $1,140.
